questions.question: Before Israel entered the promised land, Moses named seven nations living there. How did he say they compared to Israel?

answers.text: About the same size as Israel

questions.question: Moses told Israel not to let their children marry people from the nations in the promised land. Why?

answers.text: They would turn Israel's sons away to serve other gods
They would claim a share of the land Israel was given
They would bring their armies right into Israel's camp

questions.question: Moses told Israel that the LORD chose them because they were more numerous than the other peoples. True or false?
Moses said the LORD would send something against the nations in the land until even the survivors in hiding were gone. What was it?
